_readme: CO-OP ECO SERVER — players play alien, Si_RTS_AI runs their economy.
The military layer issues NO orders and builds NO producers. It still runs
its analysis and logs it, because DrMuck asked to keep the intel while the
military approach is rebuilt: 'Can you disable all military related stuff...
But we can log the military layers so to gain more intel.'
The previous soak configuration is saved as rtsai.soak-military.backup.json.
SANITY CHECK BEFORE A PLAYED ROUND — testMode is now FALSE. Left on it would
auto-join a fake client, force-end the round at 40 minutes and restart the
map underneath the players. It is the single most damaging line to leave set
from a soak config, and it is the reason this file is rewritten rather than
_notASoak: Every harness setting is off. These only ever made sense for unattended runs.
testMode false        — no fake client, no force-end, no map restart.
suppressCombat false  — players must be able to shoot. This is gated on
testMode anyway, but it is stated rather than implied.
configCycle off       — one configuration, not rotating arms.
storageBufferCaches 0 — no measurement scaffolding parked next to the Nest.
_military: OBSERVE ONLY. Deliberately 'enabled: true' with execute and produce OFF,
rather than 'enabled: false'.
enabled:false would switch off the planners too, and with them every line
worth reading — [MISSION] posture and enemy estimates, [BATTALION] what a
force would have been asked to do, [MIL/BP] which ground scores as forward,
[DEFENCE] what ranks as worth holding. Those cost nothing when nothing acts
on them, and they are the intel the rebuild needs.
WHAT IS GUARANTEED OFF, checked in code rather than assumed:
produce:false  MilitaryProduction returns before spending a single credit,
so no Greater Cyst is ever built for military reasons.
execute:false  BattalionManager never calls IssueOrders, and Owns() returns
false for every unit — which matters because two Harmony
prefixes hang off Unit.OnMoveOrder and AIGroup.OnAttackOrder.
With Owns() false they pass every order straight through, so
PLAYER AND VANILLA ORDERS ARE UNTOUCHED. That is the property
that makes this safe for a played co-op round.
blockVanillaAttackOrders:false — belt and braces on the same point. It is
already gated on execute, but a co-op server is the last
place to rely on a second condition.
offence:false  no push posture, so no armed reconnaissance either.
The map layers (enemy_pressure, enemy_value, fow_active, fow_explored) are
written by Perception regardless of any of this — they were never gated on
the military config.
_lockAlienCommander: ON, and it is what makes this co-op rather than a normal game: the alien
commander seat stays with the AI so it can run the economy for the players,
and anyone who takes it is returned to the field. Turn this off if you want
a human commander instead — the eco layer will then do nothing, because it
only acts when it holds the seat.
_eco: The tuned economy, unchanged, except for the node budget.
maxUnbuiltNodes is REMOVED on purpose. It was a flat global 3 and it still
overrides everything if present. Measured 2026-08-09: nodesInFlight was the
most common reason nothing fired at all, with 29k-38k cash idle each time,
node placement gaps reaching 209s against a 9s median, Bio Caches queued
behind it on bcAnchor and shrimps walking to distant patches as a result.
The budget is now per front — maxUnbuiltNodesPerFront x maxNodeFronts, so
3 x 2 = 6. A single chain still stays shallow, because a chain builds one
node at a time and stacking it deeper only freezes cash; two fronts get two
chains' worth instead of sharing one.
